contract.omittedWindow: identity mapping preserves current raw physical geometry
contract.explicitWindow: domain/range are a raw physical millimetre viewport, mapped affinely to width/height before body paint; chrome uses the same window
contract.oracle: D3 affine scales of independently extracted baseline actual body geometry; PDF body ownership excludes chrome, captions and outer frame

contract.bracket: rounds counts eliminations after the entrant column; results with round index greater than rounds+1 are omitted
contract.grid: gridLines counts equally spaced interior levels of both Lorentz primed axes spanning transformed window corners, with clipped actual segments
contract.beams: join adjacent duration=.5 stem tips; longer events break runs; false and isolated eighths do not add beam segments
contract.fill: complete four-corner warped cells; row-major theme ramp index; triangle pairs share color

nativeGeoPlanar.fit: uniform centred fit of all visible path vertices; raw bins and density grid unchanged
